profile.name: Shahmeer Malik
profile.summary: Full-stack software engineer with production experience in software architecture, backend and frontend development, distributed systems, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure (AWS) — including fintech-adjacent financial forecasting and RBAC-based authorization. University of Michigan CS graduate.

experience.title: Full-Stack Engineer
bullets: Took a vibe-coded prototype to production in 3 months with 1 other engineer, architecting Next.js, FastAPI, and MySQL to scale to 1,000,000 requests per day on a multi-tenant AWS SaaS platform for under $200/month

Engineered a pipeline that iteratively runs an exhaustive subset search, falling back to greedy pruning, fit memoization, and thread-pool concurrency, to aggregate and overlay external public data for sales forecasting — improving prototype forecast accuracy from 75% to 93%

Built an LLM chat bot supporting 10 model personalities across multiple providers, automating financial-analysis and forecast requests end-to-end across 11 SQS async jobs, saving roughly 2 hours/week of support time

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Redesigned production monitoring dashboards with pagination, region-based clustering, and embedded runbook links, and restructured weekly operational reviews and led multiple Correction of Error analyses, cutting incident response time from 6 hours to 50 minutes — an 85% reduction
Resolved a multi-region SSH outage caused by a 46GB transfer bypassing legacy rate limiting by adding pre-prod load testing (JUnit, Mocha) and payload-aware throttling
Eliminated recurring false-positive SSH alerts by fixing a race condition between health checks and host-patching cycles, improving on-call signal reliability

Optimized the SSH and WebSocket-SSH services in Go and TypeScript, improving connection stability for internal users by resolving false-positive error codes and integrating internal load balancing to prevent zip bomb attacks
Developed and maintained CI/CD pipelines for 4 security services, improving deployment reliability

experience.title: Intern
bullets: Ran English training sessions and mock interviews with feedback on soft and technical skills to improve refugees' employability and language proficiency
Facilitated the acquisition of passports and travel documents to help refugees relocate to safer countries

experience.title: Software Engineer (Apprenticeship)
bullets: Developed a React/Vite parametric medical-equipment design tool, reducing manual modeling time by approximately 50%
Unified over 100,000 anthropometric data points into a 3D human-body model, improving rendering efficiency by 30%
Normalized diverse data formats with singleton structure standards, improving compatibility with the Three.js rendering layer

projects.title: MiraajGames.com
projects.summary: A self-hosted arcade of 15+ original HTML5-canvas games with DMs, group chat, and leaderboards — 10,000+ lines of Next.js on AWS EC2, carrying 500+ DMs a week.
bullets: Shipped a 10,000+ line Next.js arcade with 15+ original HTML5-canvas games (Tetris, Pacman, Chess, Flappy Bird, Crossy Road, Sudoku, Battleship, and more), each built from scratch with custom physics, collision, and rendering

Modeled an 8-table Postgres schema in TypeScript with Drizzle ORM and migrated the Neon database, keeping schema, types, and queries in lockstep so data-layer errors surface at compile time instead of in production

Built DM and group-chat support with cursor-based pagination and read receipts, keeping message load latency at O(page size) regardless of conversation depth — serving dozens of monthly users and carrying 500+ DMs per week

Instrumented 30+ backend API routes with structured logging shipped to AWS CloudWatch, enabling centralized monitoring of request volume, errors, and latency across auth, messaging, leaderboard, and game endpoints

Self-hosted production on an AWS EC2 instance with an Elastic IP and IONOS domain, running the service under systemd on localhost:3000 behind Caddy terminating TLS on :443 — monetized through Google AdSense
